Name: Giantbreaker Spark
Story Background: The greater the shadow, the brighter the spark needed to break it.
Ability: Giantbreaker Spark deals 6 damage to target creature an opponent controls if its power is 4 or greater. Otherwise, it deals 3 damage to that creature.
Appearance Description: A small red-cloaked mage launches a concentrated fiery lance into the chest of a towering stone-armored giant.
